detail_script = """import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx')

# Status breakdown
print("=== BY STATUS ===")
status_grp = df.groupby('Status').agg(
    order_count=('Order ID', 'count'),
    total_paid=('Total Paid', 'sum'),
    avg_paid=('Total Paid', 'mean')
).round(2)
print(status_grp.to_string())

# Top customers by order count and spend
print("\\n=== TOP CUSTOMERS (by total spend) ===")
cust_grp = df.groupby('Customer').agg(
    order_count=('Order ID', 'count'),
    total_paid=('Total Paid', 'sum'),
    avg_paid=('Total Paid', 'mean')
).sort_values('total_paid', ascending=False).round(2)
print(cust_grp.to_string())

# Date breakdown
print("\\n=== BY DATE ===")
date_grp = df.groupby('Date').agg(
    order_count=('Order ID', 'count'),
    total_paid=('Total Paid', 'sum')
)
print(date_grp.to_string())

# Most popular items (split comma-separated items)
print("\\n=== MOST POPULAR ITEMS ===")
all_items = []
for items_str in df['Items']:
    for item in items_str.split(', '):
        all_items.append(item.strip())
item_counts = pd.Series(all_items).value_counts()
print(item_counts.to_string())
print(f"\\nTotal unique products: {item_counts.shape[0]}")
print(f"Total item mentions across all orders: {len(all_items)}")
"""
await write_file("./detail_analysis.py", detail_script)
print("Script written")
